products.name: FloatLink FL-100
products.tagline: Direct cellular monitoring for existing mechanical float gauges.
products.description: A compact outdoor telemetry module for distributed, above-ground tanks that already have a supported mechanical float gauge.
products.installationSummary: Mounts through a fictional gauge adapter and requires confirmation of gauge interface and thread dimensions.

products.name: FloatLink FL-110
products.tagline: Short-range float-gauge monitoring for clustered tanks.
products.description: A battery-powered monitor designed for groups of nearby above-ground tanks connected through a compatible Tankroy gateway.
products.installationSummary: Mounts through a fictional gauge adapter and communicates through a compatible ConnectHub gateway.

products.name: RadarSight RS-200
products.tagline: Non-contact level monitoring for open or vented tanks.
products.description: A top-mounted fictional radar monitor for applications where the sensing element should not contact the stored material.

products.name: PressureLink PL-500
